description: This file defines the ArrayExpression class used in Twig templating engine to represent and compile array expressions within templates.

classes.name: ArrayExpression
classes.description: Represents an array expression node in Twig's abstract syntax tree, capable of compiling itself into PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ArrayExpression with elements and line number, determining the highest numeric key.

methods.name: getKeyValuePairs
methods.description: Returns the array's key-value pairs as an array of pairs.

methods.name: hasElement
methods.description: Checks if a given key element exists in the array.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new element with an optional key to the array.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the array expression into PHP code, handling spread operators and key-value pairs.

methods.name: hasSpreadItem
methods.description: Checks if any element in the array has a 'spread' attribute.
